docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $3,000.00 FILED BY WONG, CRYSTLE AS TO DEFENDANT GHOSH, SHARMILA ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR JUN-10-2021 AT 01:30 PM IN DEPT 506
COPYING FEES (5 PAGE) PAID BY PLAINTIFF WONG, CRYSTLE
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF (FEE FOR SERVICE:$50.00) SERVED MAR-04-2021, PERSONAL SERVICE AS TO DEFENDANT GHOSH, SHARMILA

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF JUN-10-2021 - JUDGMENT. PLAINTIFF CRYSTLE WONG IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT SHARMILA GHOSH IS NOT PRESENT. PLAINTIFF STATES THAT AN EMAIL WAS RECEIVED FROM DEFENDANT STATING THAT SHE WOULD NOT BE PRESENT FOR TRIAL TODAY. COPY OF DEFENDANT'S EMAIL IS PROVIDED TO THE COURT. PLAINTIFF REVIEWED AND RETURNED IN OPEN COURT. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED.(506)

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF WONG, CRYSTLE RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT GHOSH, SHARMILA $2,000.00 PRINCIPAL, $100.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $2,100.00 STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS NO EXHIBITS FILED
